meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces. Also use for unpublished Zhihu, CSDN, or Toutiao drafts through a browser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 文稿排成公众号草稿,自动配图、拟标题并抹掉 AI 腔
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写完 Markdown 文章还得手动搬到公众号后台排版发布
copy.tagline_en: Turn Markdown into ready-to-publish WeChat drafts with images and titles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write in Markdown and still hand-copy posts into the WeChat editor

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调用 md2wechat 命令行:把 Markdown 转成公众号 HTML、做预览和元数据检查,按需生成配图或封面、创建草稿,并能按创作者风格改写、去除 AI 痕迹。
howto.when: 当你要求把 Markdown 转成公众号 HTML、预览或建草稿,或提到知乎、CSDN 等平台草稿、配图封面、标题建议时接管。

say.text: 把这篇 article.md 转成公众号 HTML 并预览一下
say.note: 先 inspect 检查,再 preview 输出 HTML

say.text: 给这篇文章生成一张封面图
把 article.md 里的 AI 痕迹去掉

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives the md2wechat CLI to convert Markdown to WeChat HTML, preview and inspect metadata, generate cover or article images, create drafts, write in creator styles, and remove AI traces.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to convert Markdown to WeChat HTML, preview, or draft an article, or mention unpublished Zhihu, CSDN drafts, cover images, or title suggestions.

say_en.text: Convert article.md to WeChat HTML and preview it
Generate a cover image for this article
Remove the AI writing traces from article.md
